title: Docker push to ECR denied by IAM or SCP
error_signature: AccessDeniedException ecr:BatchCheckLayerAvailability explicit deny in a service control policy, docker push failed
root_cause: An AWS Organizations service control policy has an explicit deny for the ECR action. SCPs only restrict permissions, they never grant them, and the IAM role also needs its own allow.
fix: Remove or narrow the deny statement in the SCP, then confirm the role used by the pipeline has an IAM policy that allows the ECR actions on the repository.

title: npm ci fails because package-lock.json is out of sync
error_signature: npm ci can only install packages when your package.json and package-lock.json are in sync, missing from lock file
root_cause: A dependency was added or changed in package.json without regenerating package-lock.json, and npm ci refuses to modify the lockfile.
fix: Run npm install locally, commit the updated package-lock.json, and keep the Node and npm versions the same locally and in CI.

title: pytest fails with ModuleNotFoundError in CI
error_signature: ModuleNotFoundError No module named, pytest collection error, ImportError while importing test module
root_cause: The package is not installed in the CI environment, or the project is not installed in editable mode so the tests cannot import the source code.
fix: Add the missing dependency to requirements, install the project with pip install -e . before running pytest, and make sure the workflow uses the same Python version as local development.

title: Terraform fails to acquire the state lock
error_signature: Error acquiring the state lock, ConditionalCheckFailedException, Lock Info ID
root_cause: A previous Terraform run crashed or is still running and left a lock in the DynamoDB table, so the new run cannot take the lock.
fix: Check that no other run is active, then release the lock with terraform force-unlock using the lock ID from the message. Add a concurrency group in the workflow to prevent overlapping runs.

title: Docker build fails because a file is not found in the build context
error_signature: COPY failed: file not found in build context or excluded by .dockerignore
root_cause: The file referenced by COPY is outside the build context, has a different path or case, or is excluded by .dockerignore.
fix: Check the path and case, confirm the build context directory in the workflow, and remove the file from .dockerignore if it is excluded by mistake.
